**What this module adds.** You'll learn what machine learning is, how models learn from labelled examples, and how to evaluate them with training and test data.

**Why it is valuable.** Machine learning lets computers do tasks (like coding thousands of texts) that would take humans far too long.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [Text Classification](text-classification.qmd).
